projects.name: Dekko
projects.desc: Helps a reviewer understand a pull request before reading the diff.
did: A reviewer opening a large pull request has to work out what changed and why. I built a typed change model where every claim cites the exact lines of code, so it can be checked instead of trusted.
Wrote a deterministic diagram renderer, so the same change always produces the same picture of its shape.
Added an automated grader that scores the answers about a change, so quality can be measured when prompts or models change.
Worked test-first through an agent-driven ticket workflow, with stacked pull requests.

projects.name: Skills Marketplace
projects.desc: Agent Skills (SKILL.md files) for Claude and other AI agents, published in one place.
did: Packaged reusable instructions as SKILL.md files, so an agent can load them when a task needs them.
Wrote them for Claude and kept them usable by other agents.

projects.name: Mero Pasal
projects.desc: I created this to turn my father's kirana shop’s paper bills into a searchable digital bill book.
did: Shop owners keep paper bills in a drawer and can’t search them. I built a phone app that turns them into a searchable bill book.
Built it as a progressive web app (PWA), so it installs and works on a phone without an app store.

projects.name: Chroma Rush
projects.desc: A colour-matching endless runner in Godot 4.
did: Used CrazyGames player metrics (playtime and return rate) to find where players dropped out in the first minute.
Shipped update 1.0.1 to fix it: new players start on the road, screen shake is calmer, and they get a free shield.

blocks.text: I’m Binayak Dotel, a software engineer in Bhaktapur, Nepal. For the last four years I’ve worked remotely for WhiteHat Engineering, a US company, building AI agent systems and backend services. Before that I built published Unity mobile games. In my own time I make games and small tools.
From my CV.
